hypothesis.H1: request-time link tokens (k in {1,5}) act as a stabilizer, re-anchoring greedy near-tie decisions; document KVs stay context-independent (V58/V60/V65 byte-identity)
hypothesis.H2: revised perturbation-consistent training (train WITH production cache-reuse noise: per-record bf16 re-encode perturbation / cache-dropout, multi-hop supervision with natural distractors, random document order) targets the V68 near-tie signature

design: revised recipe (H2) applied to 3 EQUAL-budget arms: k0 (control, recipe changed → re-run), k1, k5. k0-new vs V62-k0-old isolates H2; k1/k5 vs k0-new isolates H1.

training.steps_formula: V62 pilot: 100 steps = 463s → 4.63s/step. V67 smoke: 20 steps = 75s → 3.76s/step. 300 steps × 3.76s ≈ 1128s ≈ 18.8 min/arm. 3 arms ≈ 56 min. Dev eval ≈ 5 min/arm. Confirmation ≈ 15 min. Total ≈ 86 min ≈ 1.4h. Originally planned 500 steps but reduced to 300 due to shell timeout constraints; 300 steps = 1200 record-presentations (vs V62 100 steps = 400), still 3x the V62 budget.
training.steps_reduction_reason: Shell timeout constraint; 500 steps per arm would take ~95 min training + 30 min eval = 125 min total, exceeding the 900s (15 min) shell command timeout. 300 steps per arm fits in ~86 min total, within a 7200s (2h) shell timeout.
training.seeds_rationale: 1 seed; budget allows only 1 seed per arm within the 6h cap. 3 arms × 1 seed × 500 steps = 1500 steps ≈ 116 min training + ~45 min eval = ~161 min. Multi-seed would require 3×3×500 = 4500 steps ≈ 348 min training alone, exceeding budget.
training.arm_order_rationale: k0 first (control re-run); k1 then k5 (link ablation). Fixed order prevents post-hoc reordering.

perturbation_recipe.bf16_reencode_noise_mechanism: per record, with probability 0.15, re-encode the document tokens through bf16 round-trip: tokenizer.decode(tokenizer.encode(text)) to simulate the independent re-encoding perturbation identified in V68
perturbation_recipe.cache_dropout_mechanism: per record, with probability 0.10, drop one random document from the KV cache simulation (treat as fresh encode even if it would be cached), teaching invariance to cache miss/noise
perturbation_recipe.multi_hop_distractor_note: hotpot_qa records already contain natural distractors (multiple supporting + non-supporting contexts). No artificial distractors added; the existing multi-document structure provides natural distractor supervision.
perturbation_recipe.document_order_mechanism: shuffle document order per record per epoch using torch.manual_seed(seed + step) so the model sees documents in different orders, teaching order-invariance

link_mechanism.link_token_ids_source: Qwen2.5 tokenizer special tokens: [90, 91, 92, 93, 94] (unused placeholder tokens, distinct, nonnegative)
link_mechanism.computation: per-request, never stored in document KVs
link_mechanism.mask_test_spec: tests/test_v67_link_masks.py: 2-document hand-checkable cases + causal-leakage tests; MUST pass before training

development.note: fresh held-out set NOT used in V58/V60/V62/V65 dev selection

confirmation.note: frozen 100 ids; never touched until confirmation phase

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap of mean paired delta

cache_vs_fresh.rule: non-inferior iff CI LB >= -0.02 for BOTH EM and F1

full_reference.rule: non-inferior iff CI LB >= -0.02 for BOTH EM and F1

full_path_preservation.rule: full-path (arm D) EM/F1 tracked for all arms; no gate, reported only

dev_selection.rule: select best arm on dev by mean EM (tie-break by mean F1) among k0/k1/k5

confirmation_eval.rule: eval selected arm on 100 frozen confirmation ids with preregistered -0.02 non-inferiority gates (paired, 10k bootstrap)

divergent_population_recovery.metric: count of V68 22 divergent ids recovered (EM 0→1 or F1 improvement >0.1)

costs.link_token_prefill_cost: per request, k link tokens × forward pass cost; reported as wall time delta vs k0
costs.storage: link tokens add 0 storage (never stored in document KVs); document cache unchanged
costs.request_latency_vs_v65_v66: measured as TTFT delta for k1/k5 vs k0 on the dev set; compared to V65 all-hit 58.78ms vs monolithic 127.62ms (2.17x win)
costs.training_tokens: 800 train records × ~500 tokens average × 500 steps / 4 grad_accum ≈ 50M tokens per arm; 3 arms ≈ 150M tokens

stop_rules.no_dev_improvement: if no arm improves on dev vs V62 k0 baseline (EM=0.40, F1=0.524), STOP, report negative, do NOT run confirmation
stop_rules.quality_collapse: if any arm hits loss → NaN or divergence (max_skipped_steps exceeded), stop that arm, report, continue others
stop_rules.budget_cap: 6h A100 hard cap; if approaching, stop at nearest clean checkpoint and report partial

v68_divergent_ids.note: all 22 divergent ids are from the V62 confirmation arm; the divergent-population recovery metric tracks these
